youtube.title: Where did the first Olympic flame burn? Not where you think 🔥
youtube.description:
The city that revived the Games, the city of the first torch relay, or the third one? The first Olympic flame was lit by an electricity worker in a bowl on top of a stadium tower, with no relay and no Olympia. The relay came eight years later, and it was built as a propaganda show.
Which did you pick?

facebook.text:
In which city did the Olympic flame first burn — Athens, Amsterdam or Berlin?
The first flame was lit by an electricity worker in a bowl on top of a stadium tower, with no relay and no Olympia. The relay came eight years later, thousands of runners across seven countries, built as a propaganda show. Pick before the torch moves.
